first_text: (a)Photomicrograph of spleen section showing congested blood vessels and multifocal dark brown pigments suggestive of hemosiderin pigment accumulation in the splenic parenchyma (at 100x).

(b)Representative photomicrograph of liver section showing diffuse hepatocellular degeneration with atrophic changes in hepatic cords. In addition moderate degree of vascular and sinusoidal congestion is also apparent (at 100x).

(c)Photomicrograph of lung section showing thickened interstitial spaces due to severe congestion and hemorrhage in alveolar spaces. In addition, engorged blood vessels are also evident in entire parenchyma (at 100x).
